h1: How Many Custom Cups Should You Order?
lead: Start with your serving plan, then apply the selected product and printing minimums. Do not choose an order quantity from the number of guests alone.
html:
Count uses rather than heads

Separate the cups needed for initial service, refills that require a new cup, take-home gifts and operational reserve. Use your own event or venue service assumptions; there is no universal extra percentage that fits every event. For a multi-day event, decide whether the same cup stays with the guest or a new cup is issued for each service.

Check the product and artwork quantities

Most BOOM products start at 500 pieces, with selected products from 10. Printed logos start at 250 pieces for one color, 1,000 for two colors and 2,000 for three. Both the product and printing scope matter. A set is not the same unit as an individual cup, and pieces per carton is a shipping quantity rather than an automatic minimum order.

Make quotations comparable

Ask for the same model, decoration, accessories and packing at each quantity you compare. State separate artwork versions rather than assuming quantities can be pooled. The final choice should follow your actual use, budget and storage capacity; a lower unit price does not by itself make a larger total order the better purchase.
